summary: Implemented prepared SPARQL Update (prepareUpdate). Changes: added Update container in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py (prologue, algebra); translateUpdate in algebra.py now always returns an Update, building the prologue from the single declaration group for empty requests; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added in processor.py and exported from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers the specified behaviors. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests are unverified. Open risk: the initial-bindings test relies on an empty WHERE clause yielding one solution carrying initBindings; the str(op) snapshot's stability is also unconfirmed. Formatting was checked by hand, not with black. No commits made.
